**HDR Flicker Fix:** stops flicker and "No signal" with HDR at 4K 120Hz over HDMI 2.1.

### Install

1. On the Steam Machine, switch to **Desktop Mode** and open **Konsole**.
2. Paste this line and press **Enter**:
   ```
   cd ~ && curl -fsSL https://github.com/Involuntary-commit/Steam-Machine-Tweaks/releases/latest/download/hdr-10bit-fix.tar.gz | tar xz && bash hdr-10bit-fix/edid-10bpc.sh
   ```
3. Enter your password, then follow the menu.

Full guide: [HDR Flicker Fix](https://github.com/Involuntary-commit/Steam-Machine-Tweaks/tree/main/hdr-10bit-fix)
